about_the_game:
It is highly recommended to play this after completing all routes of the main story - Saihate Station.

"But what exactly is true happiness?"

The two had sworn to escape from everything and spend eternity in paradise.

However, after a long, long time had passed, the train suddenly began to move once again...

◽️Synopsis

This is an exploration horror ADV (Adventure) with a new map and scenario as additional content for the love-hate bromance exploration horror "Saihate Station."

In the main story of "Saihate Station," you control "Tatsunami Shion", who was an assist character, and as you travel by train through a ruined station bathed in the sunset, you unravel their past and go in search for true happiness.

◽️Game Features

  • The core gameplay consists of moving around and investigating (talking). There are also simple puzzles and some light action elements (like chase scenes and key input events), but the difficulty level is low.

  • The game is dialogue-heavy. Please enjoy the interactions between characters.

  • A new conversation feature has been added. While exploring, you can talk to characters to check your progress or just chat with them.

  • There are no jump scares. Compared to the main story of Saihate Station, the horror elements are minimal.

  • There are two different endings.

  • After clearing the game, bonus features such as CG gallery and in-game achievements become available.

  • Estimated playtime is 3-4 hours.

◽️Warning

This work contains depictions of physical and psychological distress caused by violence and abuse, bleeding, implications of suicide, cannibalistic imagery, disturbing sound effects, murder, and other such content.

If you have difficulty distinguishing fiction from reality, are in an unstable mental state, are sensitive to strong stimuli, or find such content distressing, please refrain from playing.

◽️How to Launch the Game

Please download "Saihate Station".

1. In your Steam Library, right-click on "Saihate Station" and select "Properties".

2. Go to the "DLC" tab and make sure that "Saihate Station - Twilight Railway" is already downloaded.

3. In the same Properties window, find the "Installed Files" tab and click the "Browse" button.

4. Open the folder named "DLCtasogare" inside the folder that appears.

5. For Windows, double-click "Game.exe"

6. For Mac, double-click "Game.app" to launch the game.

※Please note: You cannot launch this content from the main Saihate Station game.

■About Let's Plays / Streaming

Let's play or livestreaming of this software are generally prohibited.

■Soundtrack

An original soundtrack featuring newly composed tracks is available for purchase.

さいはて駅 -黄昏電鐵- Extra Soundtrack（BOOTH）

Music by: コニシユカ (nonai sound)
